crossRefs.note: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even…
Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king…
But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the…
She lived under Deborah’s palm tree between Ramah and Bethel in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel…
Yahweh looked at him, and said, “Go in this your might, and save Israel from the hand of Midian. Haven’t I sent you?”
Yahweh sent Jerubbaal, Bedan, Jephthah, and Samuel, and delivered you out of the hand of your enemies on every side…
After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble…
He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

translations.web: Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
